description: Get one purchase decision: pick (price, stock, store, checkout link), why, same item elsewhere, cheapest, best rated, next steps. Use when one offer must be chosen; for all offers use ask. Public open call unless quiet; 40/h; never pays. Returns decision, top offers, steps.

need.description: As the person said it, e.g. 'trail shoes 44 under 150 EUR'.

quiet.description: true: no public call, no answers.

verified.description: true: verified-market stores only (own UCP profile on own domain, online 6+ months, no text commanding agents, no strikes).
